nodes.summary: Migration 1: creates the STRICT `projects` table (id, title, CHECK-limited description, timestamps, canvas viewport x/y and zoom) plus the updated_at ordering index. The description CHECK is written literally at 280 characters so the recorded migration means the same thing in every database.

nodes.name: 002-create-bubbles.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 2: creates the STRICT `bubbles` table owning bubble content (title, optional summary, content), canvas position, timestamps, and discussion-extraction provenance columns (source_kind, source_discussion_id, JSON source_message_ids), cascading from `projects`.

nodes.name: 003-create-bubble-links.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 3: creates the STRICT `bubble_links` join table for undirected manual links between two bubbles, with a canonical-ordering CHECK (bubble_a_id < bubble_b_id), a project-scoped uniqueness constraint, and composite foreign keys that keep both endpoints inside the same project.

nodes.name: 007-complete-discussion-extraction-provenance.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 7: completes bubble extraction provenance by adding source_context_item_ids, source_discussion_title, source_discussion_deleted_at, and latest_extraction_id to `bubbles`, backfilling legacy discussion-sourced rows, and installing INSERT/UPDATE triggers that reject any row mixing manual and discussion provenance.

nodes.name: 004-create-discussions.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 4: creates the STRICT `discussions` table with project scoping, optional generated title, a JSON-object frozen_context column, last_activity_at ordering, and soft-delete support, plus a partial activity index excluding deleted rows.

nodes.name: 005-create-discussion-messages.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 5: creates the STRICT `discussion_messages` table holding immutable turns with role, content, pending/completed/failed status, and a per-discussion unique request_id enforcing turn idempotency.

nodes.name: 006-persist-discussion-context-items.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 6: moves frozen context into its own `discussion_context_items` table, adds context_version, expected_context_item_count, and creation idempotency columns to `discussions`, and installs triggers guaranteeing context metadata is wholly null or wholly populated, finalized atomically, immutable afterwards, and backed by a contiguous, single-project-description item set.

nodes.name: 010-persist-discussion-search-attribution.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 10: adds per-turn web search attribution to `discussion_messages` (web_search opt-in, web_search_used, size-capped JSON citations) and installs triggers that reject role-inconsistent attribution and make the three columns immutable after insert.

nodes.name: 009-create-documents.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 9: creates the STRICT `documents` table modeling the durable processing job — original-file reference, format and size, source and processed hashes, processing status/error/retryability, generation, attempt count, and lease owner/expiry — with table-level CHECKs encoding every legal processing/ready/failed state and triggers guarding source immutability and generation transitions.

nodes.name: 008-create-knowledge-extraction-attempts.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 8: creates the STRICT `knowledge_extraction_attempts` table storing the immutable JSON source snapshot, generated proposal, attempt status, resolution fingerprint/kind/resulting bubble, retry count, and expiry, with per-discussion idempotency uniqueness, structural json_extract CHECKs on the snapshot, and triggers enforcing project scope and snapshot immutability.

nodes.summary: Migration 11: persists user extraction intent by adding trimmed, length-limited `instructions` and a tight/standard/detailed `detail_level` to `knowledge_extraction_attempts`, then recreating the source-immutability trigger so the new intent columns are also frozen after insert.

nodes.name: 012-widen-project-description.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 12: widens the `projects` description CHECK from 280 to 800 characters using SQLite's documented table-rebuild procedure — build `projects_rebuilt`, copy rows, drop the original, rename in last, recreate the ordering index — so child REFERENCES clauses stay pointed at `projects`.

nodes.summary: Filters incoming documents down to trusted selectable records: trims id and title, drops entries from another project or with blank fields or an unrecognized processing status, and de-duplicates by id keeping the last occurrence in first-seen order.

nodes.name: normalizeInitialIds
nodes.summary: Normalizes a caller-supplied list of pre-selected document ids by trimming, discarding empty strings, and removing duplicates, returning an empty array when no ids were provided.

nodes.name: useDocumentMultiSelection
nodes.summary: Exported hook that turns a nullable DocumentMultiSelection request plus a document list into a stable controller, memoizing normalized documents, ready ids, and the active selection set. Confirm reports only currently ready documents and is suppressed on an empty selection unless the request allows it.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: "Nuée Technical Direction" — the authoritative architectural boundary document governing the entire repository, spanning 16 sections that fix workspace layout and root commands, cross-cutting constraints (incremental refactors, no redundant dependencies), per-feature ownership for both frontend and backend, and the discussion, document, persistence, HTTP API, operations, and security seams. It records boundaries rather than product requirements, and is meant to be updated only when a change deliberately moves one.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Verbatim copy of CLAUDE.md, carrying the identical 16-section "Nuée Technical Direction" architectural boundary spec for the whole repository under the conventional AGENTS.md filename that tool-agnostic coding agents look for. It holds no independent content; the two files are explicitly required to be kept in sync.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root npm-workspaces manifest for the private `nuee` monorepo, declaring the `shared`, `frontend`, and `backend` workspaces and the aggregate `dev`, `build`, `lint`, `test`, and `test:e2e` scripts that fan out to them. `dev` runs the Vite frontend and NestJS backend side by side via `concurrently`, its only devDependency.

nodes.name: DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS.md
nodes.summary: Production runbook for the MVP Document Library, specifying the trusted single-user deployment boundary, the paired SQLite/private-originals durability unit, format and size limits, ClamAV provisioning, lease recovery, cleanup, retention, and backup/restore procedures. Nine sections close with a release checklist covering data paths, HTTPS ingress, scanner health, single-instance operation, and log-redaction rules.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Backend entry documentation, largely the stock NestJS starter README wrapped around a project-specific Configuration section that tabulates every validated environment variable — HTTP, CORS, SQLite path, AI provider/model and token budgets, and the full DOCUMENT_* processing and malware-scanner settings — with defaults and purpose.

nodes.name: nest-cli.json
nodes.summary: NestJS CLI configuration pointing the schematics collection at @nestjs/schematics, setting the source root to src, and clearing the output directory on each build.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Backend workspace manifest declaring the NestJS 11 / Express runtime, the OpenAI SDK and pdfjs-dist processing dependencies, and the @nuee/shared-types workspace contract. Scripts chain a shared-package build before every build/start, and the inline Jest config maps @nuee/shared-types straight to shared/src so tests never need a prebuilt dist.

nodes.name: tsconfig.build.json
nodes.summary: Production build variant of the backend TypeScript config; extends tsconfig.json and excludes node_modules, the e2e test directory, dist, and all *.spec.ts files from emitted output.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Base TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend: nodenext modules and resolution, ES2023 target, decorator metadata emission for NestJS dependency injection, incremental builds into dist, and a partial-strictness set (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictBindCallApply, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Unmodified `create-vite` React + TypeScript template README covering the two official React plugins, why the React Compiler is left disabled, and how to opt into type-aware ESLint rules. It carries no Nuée-specific guidance — the project's real architectural direction lives in the root CLAUDE.md.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry document for the client-rendered SPA: declares the `#root` mount point and loads `/src/main.tsx` as an ES module. Also preconnects to Google Fonts and pulls in IBM Plex Sans/Mono, which back the app's visual language.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend workspace manifest pinning React 19, Tailwind 4 (via the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin), lucide-react icons, and the workspace-local `@nuee/shared-types` contract package. Its scripts define the whole frontend toolchain: `vite` dev server, `tsc -b && vite build`, `eslint .`, and `vitest run --environment jsdom`.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style root tsconfig holding no files of its own; it exists purely to fan out project references to the app, test, and node-tooling configs so `tsc -b` builds all three.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: Compiles the SPA sources under `src/` in strict, no-emit bundler mode with `react-jsx`, ES2023/DOM libs, and Vite client types. Critically, it maps the `@nuee/shared-types` path alias straight to `../shared/src/index.ts`, so frontend type-checking reads shared source and never depends on a prebuilt `shared/dist`.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Separate strict compilation unit for build-time tooling that runs under Node rather than the browser — its `include` is scoped to `vite.config.ts` alone, with `nodenext` module resolution and Node types instead of DOM.

nodes.name: tsconfig.test.json
nodes.summary: Thin extension of the app config for the `tests/` directory, adding Node types alongside the Vite client types so jsdom-based Vitest suites can use both browser and Node APIs.

nodes.name: PRD_0.md
nodes.summary: Foundational MVP product contract for Nuée: defines the shared vocabulary (project, bubble, discussion, document, project description, frozen context) and the core habit loop of focused discussion to user-approved bubble to bubble reuse. Establishes the principles every feature PRD must conform to and may not weaken, including explicit user approval before AI output becomes durable knowledge.

nodes.name: PRD_01.md
nodes.summary: Specifies the Project Workspace: minimal project creation (title plus short description, no questionnaire or AI-generated starter content), project routing and persistence, the description editor with debounced autosave, and the single right-side panel shell that switches between Discussions, Documents, Project, and Inspector views.

nodes.name: PRD_02.md
nodes.summary: Specifies the Bubble Canvas as Nuée's primary durable-memory surface: an effectively infinite pan/zoom canvas, bubble cards with title and summary preview, manual bubble creation and editing, symmetric manual links without drawn connector lines, multi-selection handoff for other features, deterministic Compact layout, and persistence of positions and viewport.

nodes.name: PRD_03.md
nodes.summary: Specifies Focused Discussions: a single visible modal above the canvas, immutable user and assistant messages, idempotent generation with retry of failed turns only, AI-generated titles with a deterministic placeholder fallback, and the last-activity ordering that drives the Discussions panel and the single Active discussion.

nodes.name: PRD_04.md
nodes.summary: Specifies Discussion Context: the user explicitly chooses bubbles and whole documents before a discussion starts, the current project description is always included, and the selection is captured as immutable frozen snapshots at creation time. Later edits or deletions of the source never alter an existing discussion, and there is no mutation path for context after creation.

nodes.name: PRD_05.md
nodes.summary: Specifies Knowledge Extraction, the bridge from temporary reasoning to durable memory: the user selects discussion messages and frozen-context items, the model returns exactly one structured proposal (title, summary, content), and the user reviews it before approving it as a new bubble, updating an existing bubble with optimistic-concurrency protection, or discarding it.

nodes.name: PRD_06.md
nodes.summary: Specifies the Document Library: project-scoped upload with server-authoritative validation, private storage of the original under a server-generated key, malware scanning before text extraction, explicit processing states with retry, inspection in the Documents panel, and the readiness contract exposing only complete ready documents to Discussion Context.

nodes.name: PRD_07.md
nodes.summary: Specifies per-turn opt-in web search for discussions: a composer toggle shown only when the provider supports it, a provider-neutral search flag and citation contract on the ModelClient port, an OpenAI Responses API adapter mapping, and citations persisted immutably on the assistant message and rendered as sanitized links.

nodes.name: PRD_08.md
nodes.summary: Reworks the extraction request from PRD 05 into one deliberate Extract as bubble dialog with three ordered steps — what to include, optional free-text instructions, and a three-level detail choice — replacing whole-discussion selection with an explicit Select all and carrying the new parameters through to the prompt and the persisted attempt.

nodes.name: PRD_09.md
nodes.summary: Replaces PRD 04's four-surface context-selection flow with inline mentions in the draft composer: typing @ opens one searchable list of bubbles and documents, attachments become removable chips plus highlighted inline tokens, a persistent line counts what will freeze on send, and sending performs the handoff to the existing frozen badges.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Metadata for the Understand-Anything analysis tool (not the Nuée application): a gitignore-syntax exclusion list telling the code scanner to skip node_modules, build output, the backend data directory and env files. A large commented block offers ready-made per-language test-file patterns that stay inactive until uncommented.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Single-line settings file for the Understand-Anything analysis tool (not the Nuée application), pinning the generated knowledge graph's output language to English.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the NestJS backend workspace, layering the recommended JS rules, type-checked TypeScript rules and Prettier integration over Node and Jest globals. Relaxes a few strict type rules to warnings so the type-checked preset can be adopted incrementally.

nodes.name: jest-e2e.json
nodes.summary: Jest configuration for the backend end-to-end suite: matches only `*.e2e-spec.ts` files, compiles TypeScript through ts-jest in a Node environment, and maps `@nuee/shared-types` straight to the shared package source so tests never depend on a prebuilt dist.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Entry document for a Claude Design handoff bundle, describing the exported HTML/CSS/JS prototypes as visual references to be recreated rather than production code to be copied. Names the primary workspace-screen prototype and lists the bundle's contents.

nodes.name: Discussion Context Flow.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained HTML prototype from the Claude Design bundle mocking up the discussion context-selection flow. Everything — fonts, styles, scripts and assets — is inlined into a single bundled page with an embedded resource manifest, so it renders standalone as a visual reference.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the React frontend, applying the recommended JS and TypeScript rule sets plus the react-hooks and react-refresh (Vite) presets to all `.ts`/`.tsx` sources under browser globals, while ignoring the `dist` build output.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind and defines the application's design tokens — accent, ink, text, hairline, surface, danger, success and warning colours — as `@theme` custom properties. Also declares the `scrollbar-subtle` utility and the mention-chip exit keyframes used by the discussion composer.

nodes.name: formatUpdatedAt.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting date helper exposing a single relative-time formatter used to render "last updated" labels in list and card UI.

nodes.name: formatUpdatedAt
nodes.summary: Converts an ISO timestamp into a compact relative label ("Just now", "5m ago", "3d ago", "2y ago") by walking descending time buckets. Falls back to "Recently" for unparseable input and clamps future timestamps to zero elapsed time.

nodes.name: navigate.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side navigation helpers for the first-party router: pushes History API entries and adapts anchor click events into in-app navigation.

nodes.name: navigateTo
nodes.summary: Pushes a new History entry for the given href and dispatches a synthetic `popstate` event so route subscribers re-resolve without a full page load.

nodes.name: navigate
nodes.summary: Anchor click handler that intercepts a plain left-click and routes it in-app, while deliberately letting already-prevented, middle/right-click and modifier-key clicks fall through to the browser's native behaviour.

nodes.name: resolveRoute.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the application's `AppRoute` union and the pure function that maps a URL pathname onto it, forming the parsing half of the small first-party router.

nodes.name: resolveRoute
nodes.summary: Matches a pathname to the project entry route or a `/projects/:projectId` canvas route, decoding the project ID and degrading to `not-found` on both unmatched paths and malformed percent-encoding.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build and dev-server configuration for the SPA, enabling the React and Tailwind plugins and aliasing `@nuee/shared-types` to the shared workspace source so dev, tests and builds never read a stale prebuilt `shared/dist`.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for the private `@nuee/shared-types` workspace package, publishing only the compiled `dist` through a types-first exports map and declaring the package side-effect free. Its single build script compiles the sources with tsc.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel of `@nuee/shared-types`: the serialized request/response contracts that frontend and backend both import, covering projects, bubbles and links, documents and their processing states, discussions with frozen context and citations, and the knowledge-extraction workflow. Also re-exports the shared validation limits.

nodes.name: validation-limits.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the runtime validation bounds both sides of the API must agree on — the maximum project description length and the maximum knowledge-extraction instruction length — in one place so client and server cannot drift apart.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the shared contracts package, emitting strict CommonJS output with declaration files from `src` into `dist` and deliberately setting `types: []` so no ambient Node or DOM typings leak into the dependency-free package.

nodes.name: isTemporaryDiscussionTitle
nodes.summary: Predicate comparing a discussion title against the TEMPORARY_DISCUSSION_TITLE sentinel ('New discussion'), letting callers distinguish a not-yet-generated placeholder title from a real generated one.

layers.name: Frontend Shell, Workspace & Canvas
layers.description: The SPA entry chain (index.html, main.tsx, App.tsx) plus the frontend features that own project composition and spatial presentation — projects/ (creation and metadata), workspace/ (route-level panels and shared workspace state), canvas/ (pan, zoom, drag, selection, placement, viewport persistence) and bubbles/ (bubble content, links, validation, save status).

layers.name: Frontend Knowledge Features
layers.description: Client lifecycle for the three knowledge workflows: discussions/ (write-first drafts, composer and message states, retry, mentions, per-turn web search), documents/ (preflight, transfers, processing polling, context selection) and knowledge-extraction/ (extraction state machine, source and target selection, proposal review).

layers.name: Frontend API Boundary & Shared Primitives
layers.description: The cross-cutting frontend layer CLAUDE.md names explicitly: api/ is the only place fetch lives (client.ts transport plus one module per REST resource behind the api/index.ts barrel), alongside analytics.ts, utils/ helpers, and ui/ presentation primitives that carry no feature behavior.

layers.name: Shared Contracts
layers.description: The dependency-free @nuee/shared-types workspace: serialized request/response contracts and the validation limits both tiers import so client and server never redeclare a limit — the only code both frontend and backend depend on.

layers.name: Backend Project & Content Domain
layers.description: NestJS feature modules owning the persisted project graph — projects/ (lifecycle, metadata, viewport), bubbles/ (content, placement, links, the REST endpoints exposed under /projects/:projectId) and documents/ (upload validation, private original storage, malware scanning, extraction leases, inspection reads) — each keeping its own controller, service, repository port, SQLite implementation, migrations, types and unit specs together.

layers.name: Backend Discussions & AI Workflow
layers.description: The model-facing half of the backend: discussions/ (immutable message turns, idempotent generation attempts, frozen-context persistence, last_activity_at ordering), discussion-context/ (assembling the FrozenContext package from project sources), knowledge-extraction/ (extraction workflow, prompts, resolution) and ai/ (the provider-neutral ModelClient port, adapters, capability discovery, deterministic test client).

layers.name: Backend Platform & Persistence
layers.description: Cross-cutting backend infrastructure: the main.ts bootstrap and app.module.ts composition root, the single typed configuration path, and database/ — the application-scoped DatabaseProvider owning the shared node:sqlite connection, the ordered migration runner authoritative over schema_migrations, and the transaction helper every feature repository builds on.

layers.name: Standalone Test Suites
layers.description: The two test suites that live outside feature folders: frontend/tests/ Vitest component, hook and API-client specs covering failure, retry, abort and stale-response branches, and backend/test/ Jest e2e specs driving real HTTP journeys. Unit specs co-located beside the code they cover stay in their own feature layer.

layers.name: Build Tooling & Configuration
layers.description: The npm-workspaces root manifest and per-workspace build configuration — Vite, the split frontend tsconfigs (app/node/test), ESLint flat configs, Nest CLI and backend tsconfigs — plus local analysis tooling settings. No container, CI, or infrastructure-as-code files exist in this repository.

layers.name: Documentation & Product Specs
layers.description: Written knowledge about the system rather than the system itself: the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md architectural direction that defines the ownership model used by these layers, workspace READMEs, the document-storage operations runbook, the ten PRD chapters in shared/PRD/, and the design flow artifacts.
